Everything campus life needs, nothing it doesn't

Built around what students actually use a phone for between classes — not a bloated do-everything app.

Campus Feed

Announcements, events, and posts from your university and the clubs you're part of — one scroll, not five apps.

Marketplace

Buy, sell, and find services from students on your own campus — textbooks, hostel items, hustles.

Anonymous

Say what's on your mind without your name attached, permanently — not a weekly gimmick.

Events

RSVP to what's actually happening on campus, from department seminars to weekend meetups.

Messages

Voice notes, reactions, and real conversations with people on your campus — not another group chat.

Up and running in three steps

No downloads from an app store needed — UniVerse runs right in your phone's browser.

1

Create your account

Sign up with your email, pick a username, and confirm the link we send you.

2

Choose your campus

Select your university, faculty, department, and level so your feed is about your campus.

3

Get verified

Submit proof you're a student. Verified students get the badge and full access.

Is UniVerse at your school?

Search your university

Search to check your campus

We'll show you instantly whether UniVerse is live at your school, or let you join the waitlist to be first in line.

Put UniVerse on your home screen

Open UniVerse in your browser, then add it to your home screen so it opens like a normal app.

🤖 Android (Chrome)

Open UniVerse, tap the ⋮ menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.

🍎 iPhone (Safari)

Open UniVerse in Safari, tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.

Open UniVerse

Questions, answered

Which universities can use UniVerse?

UniVerse is live at Osun State University (UNIOSUN) first. Use the search above to check your school — if it isn't live yet, join the waitlist and we'll email you when it launches.

Do I need to download it from an app store?

No. UniVerse runs in your phone's browser and can be added to your home screen so it behaves like an app. See the steps above.

How does verification work?

After signing up you submit proof that you're a student. Our team reviews it, and once approved you get a verified badge.

Is Anonymous really anonymous?

Anonymous posts show a separate anonymous username instead of your name or profile, so other students can't see who you are.

I forgot my password. What do I do?

On the login screen tap Forgot Password? and we'll email you a link to choose a new one.

I'm a Students' Union or school office. How do we get involved?

We'd love to talk. Use the partnership form below and we'll get back to you.

For SUGs & university administration

Partner with UniVerse on your campus

We're looking for Students' Union Governments and university offices to help bring UniVerse to their students — with a direct, trusted channel to reach and understand them.

  • 01 Official accounts for verified announcements, distinct from ordinary student accounts
  • 02 Real visibility into student concerns and campus sentiment
  • 03 A say in what we build next for your campus specifically
